note: Source-backed canonical relationship registry for facts that cannot be derived safely from SES identity alone. Corporate succession records are event-driven and only added with explicit documentary support. Durable brand, trade-name, market-identity and product-to-risk-carrier relationships belong here so every downstream source can reuse them; source-specific wrappers remain outside this registry. Optional market_identity metadata describes a separately identifiable consumer-facing company or platform without making it a regulated insurer or transferring the related insurer's assessment.
